comments.content: Missing break after case "priority" causes fall-through to case "tileVisible". Every guide with an explicit priority will therefore also execute guide.setTileVisible(Boolean.parseBoolean(attributeMatcher.group("valueString"))) with a null valueString, forcing tileVisible to false and corrupting the invisible-tile check. Add a break after setting priority and ensure tileVisible is only set when the key is tileVisible.

GUIDE_ELEMENT_PATTERN only matches a quoted string or digits for the value. tileVisible is a boolean and will typically be written as tileVisible=true/false without quotes, so the pattern will never match it. Adjust the regex to allow an unquoted true/false literal, or document that tileVisible must be quoted.
